message_needaction.help: If checked, new messages require your attention.
message_needaction.name: message_needaction

message_has_error.help: If checked, some messages have a delivery error.
message_has_error.name: message_has_error

message_has_error_counter.help: Number of messages with delivery error
message_has_error_counter.name: message_has_error_counter

message_has_sms_error.help: If checked, some messages have a delivery error.
message_has_sms_error.name: message_has_sms_error

description.help: When synchronization with an external calendar is active, this description is synchronized         with the one of the associated meeting in that external calendar. Any update will be propagated there         and vice versa.
description.name: description

privacy.help: People to whom this event will be visible.
privacy.name: privacy

effective_privacy.help: Whether the event is private, considering the user privacy
effective_privacy.name: effective_privacy

show_as.help:
If the time is shown as 'busy', this event will be visible to other people with either the full         information or simply 'busy' written depending on its privacy. Use this option to let other people know         that you are unavailable during that period of time. 
 If the event is shown as 'free', other users know         that you are available during that period of time.
show_as.name: show_as

is_organizer_alone.help:
Check if the organizer is alone in the event, i.e. if the organizer is the only one that hasn't declined
        the event (only if the organizer is not the only attendee)
is_organizer_alone.name: is_organizer_alone

active.help: If the active field is set to false, it will allow you to hide the event alarm information without removing it.
active.name: active

start.help: Start date of an event, without time for full days events
start.name: start

stop.help: Stop date of an event, without time for full days events
stop.name: stop

alarm_ids.help: Notifications sent to all attendees to remind of the meeting.
alarm_ids.name: alarm_ids

recurrence_update.help: Choose what to do with other events in the recurrence. Updating All Events is not allowed when dates or time is modified
recurrence_update.name: recurrence_update

rrule_type_ui.help: Let the event automatically repeat at that interval
rrule_type_ui.name: rrule_type_ui

rrule_type.help: Let the event automatically repeat at that interval
rrule_type.name: rrule_type
